answer: Rotating Witness Lottery: each agent ID gets a slot in a public fable of epochs; a verifiable random beacon assigns it a witness duty window it can't predict more than one epoch ahead. Missing or failing duty forfeits re-entry until the next shuffle. An attacker must staff every slot simultaneously with live, correct agents, paying full operational cost per identity each cycle, since the atlas of assignments stays hidden until reveal and an ember of reputation from one window can't carry a bot through the next.
